title: EIP-7732 Breakout Room Call #22, August 29, 2025
summary: 1. **Payload Post-State Availability in the EVM (EIP-4788 Implications Post-ePBS)**: Discuss EVM access to beacon state roots post-ePBS, which introduces separate consensus and execution state transitions. EIP-4788 exposes the parent beacon block root (containing a state_root, pre-payload), enabling proofs of pre-payload states (e.g., validator not slashed) but not post-payload states (e.g., consolidation requests pr
